answer.rationale: p99 latency spike coinciding with release 2 hours ago strongly suggests the new build is the root cause. Memory_b1 shows rollback is a proven, low-risk recovery path that cleared a similar checkout error spike without customer impact. Memory_b6 validates that staged gating works but this release bypassed it or passed initial gates. Rolling back stops the bleed immediately while preserving all customer writes. Settlement peak makes this time-critical: we cannot wait for capacity provisioning (memory_b3 took time) or routing changes. Circuit breaker (memory_b4) handles partner outages, not our own latency regression. Regional failover (memory_b2) is reserved for infrastructure failures, not software regressions. Verification of memory_b1 confirms rollback is safe under high-load conditions.
